text:
ana: Figma link — trying a compact 'token-line' variant that condenses the token counter into the composer rail. Thoughts? https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ jordan: @ana I like the density, but worried about discoverability. If token-line collapses, users might miss live regen counts. Maybe hover reveal? kevin: From runtime side, moving the counter into composer is fine. Need to ensure streaming updates don't cause layout shift (we'll debounce to 200ms). maria: @kevin debounce=200ms sounds ok. Also we should keep an explicit 'Stop' affordance distinct from 'Regenerate' to avoid accidental loss. jordan: Agree. Microcopy: use 'Stop stream' vs 'Regenerate' — shorter. For tooltip text: 'Stop streaming response' (for a11y + screen readers). sam: A11y nit: ensure the stop button gets aria-pressed/aria-live? Suggest using aria-labels and live region for token updates. E.g.: ```
Tokens: 124
``` ana: Nice. UX Q: in compact mode, should token-line show cumulative token count or only last response tokens? Product leaning to cumulative for cost transparency. maria: Cumulative seems more useful. But make it subtle — secondary text color and smaller font. kevin: Cumulative updates add load on websocket traffic if we update per token. We'll send batched updates every 500ms and include both 'session_total' and 'last_response' in payload. jordan: Interaction: keyboard: map ESC to stop streaming when composer focused? Potential conflict with global ESC (close modal). Could be Shift+Esc. sam: Prefer Ctrl+Esc? But browser differences... maybe keep Escape + aria-confirmation prompt? Quick test required. ana: Let's prototype both. I'll push a small build to sandbox and tag you all. Also tweaking prompt library quick-insert: show token estimate next to prompt name. deploy-bot: deploy: playground/sandbox/tokenline-compact -> staging at 2026-03-23T10:24Z :rocket: jordan: :thumbsup: I'll add a11y labels and update Figma states for hover reveal + keyboard state. maria: I'll add to release notes: 'Compact token-line + stop/regenerate clarification'.
